reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co.

I only looked at what she can see herself. The share has no Brackenwater account files: no contract, CRM entry or profile. Nothing in #central-team mentions their renewal date either.

In my reply I said we should treat 8 April as unverified. I suggested not recording it as the renewal date until someone checks it against the signed contract or the account owner confirms it. I also asked her who owns the account so I can follow up with them.

I didn't change any records, send any mail or ask for any approvals. A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to discuss in the channel.
